text: DEFONEOS — NIO Northern Ireland Office AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 — Transparency & Compliance: This pack maps sovereign AI governance obligations for NIO devolved governance, policing oversight, and legacy institutions in Northern Ireland. High-risk classification under Annex III. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × NIO × Northern Ireland × Policing × Devolution NIO Northern Ireland Office AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for the Northern Ireland Office — covering devolution settlement, policing oversight, legacy institutions, security, border management, and British-Irish relations across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Devolution 1. Stormont & Devolved Government Northern Ireland Assembly (90 seats), Executive formation, d'Hondt mechanism, cross-community consent. Petition of concern, ministerial code, Programme for Government, and legislative consent motions under the NI Act 1998. Policing 2. Policing & Justice PSNI oversight (8,500 officers), NI Policing Board, Police Ombudsman, Policing & Community Safety Partnership. Justice devolution, organised crime, paramilitary threat, and community policing across 11 council areas. Legacy 3. Legacy & Reconciliation Independent Commission for Reconciliation & Information Recovery (ICRIR), Troubles pension scheme, inquest reform, oral history archive. Legacy Investigation Branch, Police Legacy Unit, and victims' pension administration. Security 4. Security & Counter-Terrorism MI5 lead for NI, paramilitary monitoring, threat level management (SEVERE), border security. Dissident republican and loyalist group tracking, Explosive Ordnance Disposal, and protected persons programme. Border 5. Windsor Framework & Border Irish Sea border, customs declarations, SPS checks, green/red lane for trade. Trader Support Service, movement certification, Sanitary & Phytosanitary Inspection, and trusted trader schemes. Identity 6. Identity & Citizenship Irish passport holders in NI, British/Irish dual identity, Good Friday Agreement birthright provisions. Electoral identity, driving licence jurisdiction, national insurance, and social security cross-border coordination. Economy 7. Economic Development Belfast Region City Deal (£1bn), Derry-Londonderry growth deal, Invest NI, InterTradeIreland. Shared Island Fund, Peace Plus programme, enterprise zones, and skills pipeline. Relations 8. British-Irish Relations Intergovernmental Conference, North-South Ministerial Council, British-Irish Council, East-West strand. Strand One (NI internal), Strand Two (North-South), Strand Three (East-West) governance architecture. Community 9. Community Relations Together: Building a United Community (T:BUC) strategy, shared education, shared housing, interface barriers. Community transformation, good relations indicators, and peace walls programme. Justice 10. Civil & Criminal Justice NI Courts & Tribunals Service, Public Prosecution Service, Legal Aid Agency NI. Juryless Diplock legacy, coroner's inquests, and judicial appointments. Veterans 11. Armed Forces & Veterans NI veterans' welfare, Operation BANNER legacy, in-service NI postings, veterans' gateway. Armed Forces Covenant NI adaptation, regimental connections, and memorial care. Accountability 12. Parliamentary Accountability NI Affairs Committee, NI Questions, Westminster reserved matters, Statutory Instruments. Secretary of State powers, direct rule provisions, and emergency legislation. 8 Transformation Priorities Priority 1 Stormont Digital Governance Bill passage tracking 4wk→real-time, committee evidence processing -70%. AI-assisted Assembly operations, legislative drafting support, and committee report analysis. Target: full digital legislative pipeline for restored Assembly. Priority 2 PSNI Intelligence Fusion Threat assessment processing 72h→6h, cross-border alert latency -80%. Multi-source intelligence fusion from PSNI, An G
